g.text: BODY PLAN (stations 0–10)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: NOTES

text.style: font-size: 5.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: 1. Double ended: pointed stem and pointed stern, no transom. 27 ft x 6 ft, clinker built,

text.style: font-size: 5.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: nine strakes on 68 frames, wych elm, as the RN whaler type was built from the 1890s.

text.style: font-size: 5.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: 2. Draught 1 ft 5 in with the drop keel raised; the load waterline drawn here is solved from

text.style: font-size: 5.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: the weight table, not assumed, and lands within 5 mm of the documented figure.

text.style: font-size: 5.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: 3. Five oars, single banked: three from the port side and two from the starboard. The

text.style: font-size: 5.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: bowman's oar is a foot shorter than the other four.

text.style: font-size: 5.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: 4. Standing-lug yawl rig: 16 ft 6 in mainmast, 13 ft mizzen, 15 ft 3 in main yard. Canvas is

text.style: font-size: 5.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: carried furled and stopped along the yards, which is the stowed condition.

text.style: font-size: 5.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: 5. Drop keel in a trunk amidships, worked by an iron plate head and handle; plate shown up.
